Every UD chemical engineering student takes CHEG304, "Random Variability in Chemical Processes." The course materials use MATLAB, so I put together this guide to the equivalent Python functions, with examples, warnings, and notes. 

One of these days I will have enough free time to fill this in more, though I doubt a single soul will ever use it.
